name: salvage-intake-hardening
description: warren-adc1: per-run in-flight caps reuse the EventStreamLimiter per-key limiter (src/server/stream-limits.ts) keyed on run id with maxPerClient 1 / maxGlobal 0 / no lifetime, rejecting with the family's 503 + Retry-After shape; tmp-file staging (write + rename) must be wrapped in try/finally with rm(force).catch() so failed writes never leak staged files onto the control-plane volume.

name: persist-gc-outcomes-warren-side
description: warren-9b77: persist GC/reap destructive outcomes warren-side by nulling runs.burrow_id (clearBurrowIdForWorkspace in src/db/repos/runs-workspace.ts) — the findStrandedBurrows candidate set derives from that column, so the sweep and the readyz stale_burrow_workspaces diagnostic converge with no schema change. RunsRepo delegates live in sibling free-function files to hold runs.ts under the 500-line check:size budget.

name: sandbox-lift
description: warren-5af7 lifted burrow's sandbox layer into src/sandbox/ (types/bwrap/seatbelt/cgroup/env/sandbox + tests). Key adaptations vs burrow source: SandboxProfile.home is a REQUIRED writable host dir bound at SANDBOX_HOME_PATH=/home/sandbox (warren-c865 mandate — harness state out of the git worktree); env knob renamed BURROW_SANDBOX_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB -> WARREN_SANDBOX_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB; cgroup leaf prefix warren-sb-, shim warren-cgexec; prepareSandboxCgroup split into helpers to satisfy biome complexity ceiling 15. Dead code until warren-413d wires LocalProvider.

title: LocalProvider dual-mode: in-process engine vs legacy burrow client
rationale: src/runs/reap/** is frozen for warren-413d and reap test-helpers construct LocalProvider with a fake burrow client, so legacy mode must survive until warren-9a26; production boot wires no client so the daemon leaves the spawn path now.

title: Burrow daemon fully off the runtime (warren-9a26)
rationale: The daemon was already off the spawn path (warren-413d) and preview path (warren-4bf3); the supervisor channel it served no longer existed, so the process supervision, socket polling, restart budget, and token validation were dead code guarding nothing.

name: docker-provider-spawn-seam
description: DockerProvider (warren-3732) reuses LocalEngine wholesale by injecting only the drive-loop spawn seam (DriveDeps.spawn): makeDockerSpawn maps SandboxProfile+SpawnCommand onto 'docker run' with host-path-parity bind mounts, --env-file secrets, --memory/--cpus cgroup limits, and a post-exit OOMKilled inspect probe (no --rm). Loopback WARREN_API_URL rewrites to host.docker.internal via --add-host host-gateway.

name: per-project-runtime-override-threading
description: Per-project runtime overrides (warren-fabb pattern): .warren/config.yaml key -> DefaultsConfigSchema -> spawnRun copies onto RunSpec -> provider consumes. DockerProvider reaches it through SandboxProfile.agentImage (the drive-loop spawn seam only sees profile+command); K8sProvider reads spec.agentImage directly in buildRunPod. Precedence: project override > WARREN_*_AGENT_IMAGE env > default. LocalProvider ignores container-only knobs.

warren-81e0: 'No API key found for openrouter' under DockerProvider was env-allowlist drift, not argv/HOME. Dispatch precedence (operator > project .warren/config.yaml defaults > agent frontmatter) overrode pi's anthropic frontmatter with openrouter, but PI_PROVIDER_ENV_KEYS in src/runtime/local/profile.ts was a hand-maintained burrow relic missing openrouter. Any table that shadows the canonical PROVIDER_ENV_REGISTRY (src/core/providers.ts) will drift — derive it instead.
resolution: Derived PI_PROVIDER_ENV_KEYS from PROVIDER_ENV_REGISTRY; added openrouter passthrough regression test + registry-coverage drift guard in profile.test.ts.

name: campaign-controller-tick-order
description: campaign-controller tick (warren-d050): runTick composes admission -> dispatcher -> pr-intent -> reconciler in fixed stage order; one campaign lease (tick:<id>) refuses concurrent ticks; at most one new dispatch per tick; post-loop dispatcher.reconcileAfterRestart() fails closed unconfirmed dispatches; a completed campaign cannot re-render a PR intent (intender accepts only approved/running), so the tick returns campaign_not_active

GKE Autopilot node auto-upgrade to containerd 2.1.7 (2026-08-25) broke the warren-cb93 uid split: containerd 2.x grants pod-spec capabilities.add to a non-root pid 1 in the BOUNDING set only (CapEff/CapPrm/CapAmb=0), so the entrypoint's setpriv failed setresuid with EPERM and exited 127 (SETPRIV_EXIT_PRIVERR) on every run, misclassified as no_model_response. Diagnosed by running a canary pod with the exact agent securityContext and reading /proc/self/status Cap* lines.
resolution: warren-950d: file caps on setpriv (setcap cap_setuid,cap_setgid+ep in Dockerfile.agent) + allowPrivilegeEscalation:true on the agent container (NNP off lets file caps apply; caps.add still needed because file caps intersect bounding). Agent stays sealed via setpriv --no-new-privs + --bounding-set=-all (verified live: climb-back fails EPERM/127). Watchdog cross-uid kill routes through setpriv (withCrossUidKill); DockerProvider pins --security-opt no-new-privileges; deploy gated by scripts/k8s-uid-drop-canary.ts; preflight refusal reaps as spawn_failed.

name: watchdog-kill-zombie-recovery
description: Watchdog-kill zombie recovery (warren-7f0b): the K8s in-pod idle watchdog emits a stdin_hold_timeout system witness before killing the harness; when the pod still reads Running (entrypoint finalize poller alive), the host-side watchdog terminal-reconcile net (src/runs/watchdog-reconcile.ts) keys off that witness on stream=system to reap the run failed(agent_died), which parks the finalize intent the pod polls for — driving in-pod salvage before the emptyDir disappears. inferFailureReason classifies the same witness; general infra-death salvage stays warren-6c94.

campaign-controller tick (warren-968d): a run settling terminal during the post-loop restart sweep completed the campaign before the pr_intent stage ran, so single-issue campaigns never rendered their intent. Fix: render pr_intent for sweep-settled terminal work items before settleCampaign, and admit 'completed' campaigns in the pr_intent gates so the deterministic pr-intent:<campaignId>:<workItemId> action key backfills already-completed campaigns idempotently.
resolution: Second intent pass after the restart sweep, before settleCampaign; relaxed campaign-status gate to include completed; verified by new tick tests reproducing the interleaving via a FakeWarrenServer per-read hook.

name: subscription-oauth-token-dispatch
description: Claude Max subscription auth works end-to-end through warren: a run dispatched on the macOS LocalProvider with ONLY CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in the server env (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) completed and pushed its branch (run_zqf52t76x4m3, 2026-08-27 spike). The anthropic provider optionalEnvKeys (src/core/providers.ts) + local profile allowlist already forward the token into the sandbox; claude-code -p honors it headlessly in a fresh HOME. Caveats: claude-code harness only; costUsd still renders an API-priced estimate (plan pl-26f3 step 5 fixes display).

name: cost-basis-wire-field
description: costBasis wire field (warren-f3c3): run-stemmed enum (RUN_COST_BASES/RunCostBasis) lives in src/core/wire-cost.ts sibling and re-exports through src/core/wire.ts; detection (resolveRunCostBasis in src/core/providers.ts) reads provider+env beside PROVIDER_ENV_REGISTRY; new UI-reachable core files must be added to src/ui/tsconfig.app.json include or build:ui fails TS6307; over-budget files get refactored (sibling-module split), never budget-raised

name: pi-local-model-recipe
description: Local models with the pi runtime: pi 0.84.3 does NOT read OPENAI_BASE_URL (the optionalEnvKeys comment in src/core/providers.ts implies it does, but that env-forwarding path is dead for pi). The working recipe is a pi extension calling pi.registerProvider with a baseUrl, seeded via the agent definition's pi_extensions section, loaded via frontmatter.pi.extension (explicit -e paths survive the forced --no-extensions), with frontmatter.provider naming the registered provider. Smoke-tested against Ollama in warren's exact rpc argv shape with an empty HOME: full lifecycle, tool calls work. Seeded agents need frontmatter.source=builtin or later seed-file edits never upsert. Documented in docs/local-models.md.

name: campaign-controller second-profile onboarding
description: Onboarding a second repo profile (warren-c7f5) is pure data plus one golden fixture file: prBodyContract/commentTemplates/bot-grammar/evidenceTiers live under extensions/campaign-controller/profiles/, while e2e fixtures (headings, bot logins, commands) must live in src/acceptance/__golden__/ to stay inside the pr-body leak guard's only exemptions. Gotchas hit: bot grammars validate fail-closed (no 'comment' key, JS ?<> named groups, valid GitHub logins — no [bot]); the pr_intent journaled action stays 'planned' in dry-run ticks and blocks a follow-up beginAction until the intent settles; work-item status after merge is 'merged', not 'terminal'; report followUpIterations counts warren-dispatch-type actions only. Salvage lesson: warren rescue branches can be based on an older commit — diff the salvage against HEAD first and restore unrelated files (docs, .seeds, .mulch, prose budgets) that got reverted by the base skew.

name: k8s-pod-signal-graceful-finalize
description: warren-01d5 cost-cap K8s salvage: the K8s pod's in-pod finalize/salvage only runs after the agent exits, so any pod deletion (provider.cancel via bridge cost-cap trip or operator cancelRun) used to SIGKILL the entrypoint with the emptyDir — committed work unrecoverable. Fix shape: agent-entrypoint installs a termination-signal handler (deps.registerCancelSignal, injected for tests; SIGTERM/SIGINT wired in the import.meta.main main block) that latches, emits cancel_requested, kills the agent child, and lets runAgentEntrypoint fall through into runFinalizeEntrypoint with a bounded WARREN_CANCEL_FINALIZE_MAX_WAIT_MS (25s) intent poll; WARREN_K8S_CANCEL_GRACE_SECONDS default raised 30s->90s to fit the salvage budget. When warren parks the finalize intent in time the branch is pushed in-pod; otherwise the no-intent salvage bundle is banked before exit.

warren-6397: agent-image toolchain gzips the UI build ~1.3-1.5KB cooler than CI, so check:bundle-size --update inside a warren pod corrupted budgets via lowers; updateBudgets now refuses lowers when isWarrenRunEnv() detects WARREN_RUN_ID/WARREN_API_URL/WARREN_AGENT_RUNTIME.
resolution: Guard shipped: refuses to write a lower inside a warren run, prints why, points at CI-matching rebaseline; raises within AUTO_RAISE_CAP still apply. Verified with unit tests.

name: k8s-pod-memory-sample
description: warren-fe11: K8s finalize-time pod memory sampling — pod-memory-sample.ts never-throwing metrics.k8s.io sampler + stampPodMemorySampleEvent appended to FinalizeResult.events (replayed by reap); Autopilot clamps memory limit=request, 4GiB proposal saves ~14/mo

content: runs stage timestamps (warren-7116): workspace_ready_at/agent_ready_at/agent_ended_at/reaped_at decompose the run wall clock. Runtime -> domain edges go through callbacks (DriveDeps.onWorkspaceReady / PodWatcherDeps.onWorkspaceReady) wired at boot in server/main/index.ts + runtime-wiring.ts, never direct db writes from src/runtime. agent_ready_at lives in RunsRepo.claimById (same instant as started_at); agent_ended_at stamps at reapRun entry (null for never-claimed runs); reaped_at stamps in transitionToTerminal. All stage writers are first-write-wins (runs-stage.ts). Note: file-size budgets are frozen at zero headroom — any schema/UI type addition in sqlite.ts or src/ui/src/api/types.ts requires condensing adjacent comments in the same file to stay under the ratchet.
